bug_semantics: Unauthenticated CWE-78: POST /import overwrites crontab.db with an arbitrary NeDB file, so an attacker can plant a job document whose hook field is later concatenated unsanitized into a shell command. crontab.js makeCommand (HEAD crontab.js:67-68) appends `; if test -f ${stdout}; then ${tab.hook} < ${stdout}; fi` with no quoting. The UI save path (buildCrontab) never sets hook, so the field is reachable only via raw DB import. After import, GET /crontab (set_crontab → exec crontab), POST /runjob, or --autosave/ENABLE_AUTOSAVE fs.watchFile applies the crontab and executes the hook. Default auth is off (BASIC_AUTH_USER/PWD optional). CVE.org/GHSA: published, not withdrawn; affected 0 through 0.4.2.
flaw_origin: The hook sink was first written in b207df5332b9c6a017d6d12a6ca5b405d128b2c0 (2016-12-12, package 0.2.2) as a beta feature inside set_crontab: when logging was true and tab.hook was set, the crontab line included `then " + tab.hook + " < " + tmp_hook`. Parent 4226311766b59d2c51b22238e4369b5d5a8e18b7 has no tab.hook. POST /import already existed from 00746b436708fccbb6dcde5a06d55d3c414daeb7 (2015-06-15) and still blindly write-streams the upload onto crontab.db. ecfe9faa586674dccfa20aab3d95f7e7ab5a48a2 (2026-04-19 Major revamp) extracted makeCommand and kept the same interpolation (now regardless of logging); that is a refactor, not a first-write BIC.

reasoning: Vulnerability first: CVE-2026-72589 / GHSA-r4j6-x8h7-4f8w is a real published CWE-78, not withdrawn/rejected. The attack is unauthenticated POST /import of a crafted crontab.db planting a NeDB document with hook (and logging true on the original path), then applying crontab via GET /crontab, runjob, or autosave so makeCommand interpolates hook into a shell string executed by cron. The smallest first-write of those vulnerable lines is b207df5332b9c6a017d6d12a6ca5b405d128b2c0, which introduced `if (tab.hook)` concatenation in set_crontab. Immediate parent 4226311766b59d2c51b22238e4369b5d5a8e18b7 was checked directly and has no tab.hook; the commit is a single-parent non-merge (not a squash/move/revert). POST /import (00746b43, 2015) is the delivery that already existed; the CWE-78 mechanism begins when hook is treated as a shell command. BIC precedes first tagged affected release v0.3.5 and v0.4.2; no patched tag exists. AI judgment is BIC-only: 2016 author/committer alseambusher@gmail.com, empty trailers, no bot author. The 2026 Major revamp is ignored for attribution. Closed NOT_AI with unpatched.confirmed because HEAD 870d958 / v0.4.2 still contain the sink and unvalidated import.

unpatched.reason: No upstream commit after CVE-2026-72589 (2026-08-10) sanitizes tab.hook or schema-validates POST /import. Latest tag v0.4.2 and HEAD 870d958669d64dca1d27ff7bf5d616d17ee7553b (package 0.4.2) still concatenate tab.hook into the crontab shell string and overwrite crontab.db from an uploaded file.

potential_fix.approach: Stop interpolating tab.hook into the crontab/shell string in makeCommand; on POST /import, parse the upload as NeDB job records and accept only known fields (name, command, schedule, logging, mailing, stopped, _id), dropping hook and other extras, instead of blindly overwriting crontab.db.
potential_fix.rationale: The CWE-78 sink is unsanitized concatenation of attacker-planted tab.hook into a command executed by cron. Removing that interpolation closes execution even if a hook field is already on disk; schema-validating import removes the unauthenticated plant path the advisory describes.
